# NodeDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasNodeDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasNodeDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasNodeDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasNodeDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A graph / network, or a node editor whose nodes are panels with typed sockets

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasNodeDiagramExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasNodeDiagramExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasDiagramViewport](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDiagramViewport.md)
- [CircleDiagramInfographicVariants](../../UltraCanvas/CircleDiagramInfographicVariants.md)
- [UltraCanvasCompositorDiagramExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCompositorDiagramExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasERDiagram](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasERDiagram.md)
- [UltraCanvasPacketDiagram](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPacketDiagram.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasNodeDiagram> CreateNodeDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasNodeDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### enum `NodeSizeMode`

NEW in 2.2.0: how a node's rendered size is derived.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Fixed` | node.width / node.height are used verbatim (2.0 behaviour) |
| `ByDegree` | size = baseSize * sqrt(degree), clamped to \[minSize, maxSize\] |
| `ByValue` | size = baseSize * sqrt(node.value), clamped the same way |

### enum `NodeDegreeMode`

NEW in 2.2.0: which connections count toward a node's degree.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Total` | Incoming + outgoing (default - undirected reading) |
| `Incoming` | Links where the node is the target |
| `Outgoing` | Links where the node is the source |

### enum `NodeLabelFit`

NEW in 2.4.0: what happens when a node's label does not fit the node.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Overflow` | 2.3 behaviour: the label is drawn at its font size, whatever the node |
| `ShrinkFont` | the font shrinks until the label fits, to minFontSize; then an ellipsis |
| `GrowNode` | the node grows until the label fits at its font size |
| `ShrinkThenGrow` | the font shrinks to minFontSize first; what still does not fit grows the node |

### struct `NodeDiagramSizing`

Both scaling modes use a square-root transfer so the node AREA - not its diameter - is proportional to the underlying quantity. That is the perceptually correct mapping for circular/square marks; scaling the diameter linearly makes a degree-9 hub look 9x more important than a degree-1 leaf instead of 3x.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `NodeSizeMode mode = NodeSizeMode::Fixed` |  |
| `degreeMode` | `NodeDegreeMode degreeMode = NodeDegreeMode::Total` |  |
| `baseSize` | `double baseSize = 26.0` | Size of a degree-1 (or value-1) node |
| `minSize` | `double minSize = 18.0` | Floor - keeps isolated nodes clickable |
| `maxSize` | `double maxSize = 96.0` | Ceiling - keeps a mega-hub from eating the canvas |
| `keepAspect` | `bool keepAspect = true` | When true (default) width and height are scaled together, so circles stay circular and squares stay square. When false only the width scales and the height keeps whatever the node was created with - useful for label-bearing rectangles that must stay one text line tall. |

### struct `NodeDiagramLabelFit`

The fit is per shape: a label sits in the widest band of its shape at its own height, so a circle holds a name nearly as wide as its diameter, a diamond or a triangle far less. The paddings are the gap between the text and that band's edge, in world units.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `NodeLabelFit mode = NodeLabelFit::ShrinkThenGrow` |  |
| `minFontSize` | `double minFontSize = 7.0` | ShrinkFont / ShrinkThenGrow stop here |
| `paddingX` | `double paddingX = 6.0` | Each side of the text |
| `paddingY` | `double paddingY = 3.0` | Above and below the text |

### struct `NodeDiagramGroup`

NEW in 2.2.0: a cluster container - a boundary box drawn around a set of member nodes, with an optional title. Bounds are recomputed from the members on every layout/drag, so the box tracks its contents automatically.

| `labelFontSize` | `double labelFontSize = 12.0` |  |
| `labelMargin` | `double labelMargin = 6.0` |  |
| `visible` | `bool visible = true` |  |
| `freeBounds` | `bool freeBounds = false` | NEW in 2.5.0: a free-placed region. When set the box is `bounds` (world units) as given - no padding, no room added for the title - and nodeIds no longer shape it: they still name the group's members for GetNodeGroupId(), the cohesion force and the legend. A region stays where it is put: the layouts neither move it … |
